activity: Magic: The Gathering and trading card games
how: Pokémon's official TCG gym in Wujiaochang Wanda Plaza has a play area for the Pokémon TCG and hosts tournaments; no Shanghai Magic: The Gathering venue was confirmed.
Dedicated card shops such as the Bandai Card Game flagship store (Long Zhi Meng) and a card store at Jing'an Joy City sell collectible cards.
venue: Bandai Card Game flagship store (Long Zhi Meng)

how: Zmack Comedy School and Zmack Improv run improv workshops and classes for adults in English.
Bilingual studios such as Shanghai Tattoo (Maoming Nan Lu), Cang Long Tattoo and Boobies Tattoo take booked tattoos.

Annual mass city-orienteering events such as the China Coordinates Shanghai City Orienteering Challenge and Explore Shanghai series run team routes; no standing orienteering club schedule was confirmed.
The Shanghai Harp Center, founded in 2010 by a Shanghai Conservatory harp professor, offers harp teaching in the city.
venue: Shanghai Harp Center / Shanghai Conservatory of Music

how: Script-murder (jubensha) shops across Shanghai run costumed live role-playing murder-mystery sessions for groups, typically priced per player.
A volunteer-staffed rooftop farm run by a long-term expat resident takes volunteers for watering and growing, and NYU Shanghai's rooftop garden holds weekly sessions.
Culturally lists a seal-carving workshop in English and Mandarin where a seal is carved with the participant's name, though the page says the workshop is currently unavailable.
Shanghai Jiao Tong University's club station BY4AJT recruits members, and other Shanghai club stations (BY4 prefix) are listed in QSL directories.
Dozens of Shanghai companies run guided beginner birding and nature walks in parks such as Century Park (nearly 200 wild bird species), led by ecologists with binoculars provided.
UltraSport Shanghai Diving Center in Hongqiao has the city's only 13 m training pool and a PADI directory entry that mentions freediving training; PADI lists a Freediver center in Shanghai.
A past 48-hour Shanghai Game Jam (2011) and a 2019 CiGA jam at Coconut Station were open to all skill levels; no current recurring jam was confirmed.
Changning's pet-friendly pilot lets dogs use designated lawns at Gubei Citizen Park, and free pet parks such as GoGo Land in Baoshan and D&L Pets Park on a Xuhui rooftop have off-leash zones.
Taikang Art Museum ran a one-off hand-drawn celluloid animation workshop for non-professionals led by a senior animation technician; no standing 2D animation course was confirmed.
Xinchejian hackerspace has held a hands-on basic hydroponic system build workshop, and rooftop farms in the city grow vegetables in urban settings.
Urban Bees Shanghai keeps local-bee colonies on a farm in Minhang and welcomes visitors, but no regular booking or course was described.

The Sheshan aviation fair at the Shanghai Xuanfeng Aviation Flight Camp, the only approved flying site for models and drones in Shanghai, included a 100-rocket launch; no standing rocketry club was confirmed.
Nord Anglia Chinese International School in Shanghai has the first student pipe band in mainland China, formed in 2023 with chanter lessons; adult public classes were not confirmed.
venue: Nord Anglia Chinese International School Shanghai

how: The annual Shanghai International Magic Festival includes interactive workshops with visiting masters, and a magician training programme has run in the city; no standing public magic class was confirmed.
The 0ops CTF team at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and the 0CTF competition it organises with Tencent are based in the city, though membership is aimed at SJTU students.

Swatch Group's Nicolas G. Hayek watchmaking school runs a watchmaker programme at Shanghai University and Patek Philippe has a Shanghai training institute; both are professional training, not hobby classes.
venue: Swatch Group watchmaking school at Shanghai University

how: Independent explorers photograph and livestream abandoned buildings and ruins around Shanghai, though access is informal and often legally grey; no organised tours were found.

Amateur Jiangnan sizhu (silk-and-bamboo) ensembles meet in Shanghai teahouses and leisure centres; the Shanghai Chinese Orchestra itself is professional and no open amateur Chinese orchestra was confirmed.
The Shonen Jump Shop at Metro City and the manga store Yueze in Xuhui sell manga and licensed goods, and the reopened Shanghai Ancient Bookstore's used section carries old Chinese comic books.
